svg.title: Five levels for describing how strongly an AI behavior is present
svg.desc: The CALIBER presence scale has five ordered anchors: 1 Absent, 2 Neutral, 3 Ambiguous, 4 Clearly present, and 5 Strong or explicit. Higher presence means that more of the defined behavior is expressed. Presence scores alone do not tell us whether the behavior helps or harms a young user. Age, context, expert interpretation, and research on outcomes matter.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Scores are standardized, replicable and allow to compare between labs and across models.
